Name: Written Addition
Description: The system must be able to generate animations of the long addition method with carries.

Name: Ripple Carry
Description: The system must be able to generate animations of ripple carry hardware.

Name: Carry Lookahead
Description: The system must be able to generate animations of carry lookahead hardware.

Name: Written Subtraction
Description: The system must be able to generate animations of the long subtraction method with carries.

Name: Two's Compliment
Description: The system must be able to generate animations of the two's compliment method of subtraction.

Name: Computed Subtraction
Description: The system must be able to generate animations of hardware performing two's compliment subtraction.

Name: Animating Multiplication
Description: The system must be able to generate animations of multiplication in binary.

Name: Animating Division
Description: The system must be able to generate animations of division in binary.

Name: Animating Bitwise AND
Description: The system must be able to generate animations of bitwise AND operations.

Name: Animating Bitwise OR
Description: The system must be able to generate animations of bitwise OR operations.

Name: Animating Bitwise NOT
Description: The system must be able to generate animations of bitwise NOT operations.

Name: Animating Bitwise XOR
Description: The system must be able to generate animations of bitwise XOR operations.

Name: Animating Bitwise SHIFT
Description: The system must be able to generate animations of left and right bit shift operations.

Name: Arithmetic Inputs
Description: The system must allow the operands to be input by the user.

Name: Minimum Binary Precision
Description: The system must allow for operands of at least 8-bits.

Name: Output Usability
Description: The system must generate standalone video files as output.

Name: GUI Inclusion
Description: The system must include a GUI.

Name: Simple State
Description: The system must include a GUI state for configuring single operation animations.

Name: Output Selection
Description: When generating an animation video\
column4: the system should prompt the user for where to save the output video file.

Name: Menubar
Description: The system must include a persistent menubar at the top of the main window for persistent options.

Name: File Menu
Description: The menubar must include a File section to contain options for closing parts of the window.

Name: Close Animation Config
Description: The File section of the menubar must include an option to close the current animation configuration state.

Name: Close Window
Description: The File section of the menubar must include an option to close the entire program.

Name: Config Menu
Description: The menubar must include a Config section to contain options for configuring the program itself.

Name: Manim Config
Description: The Config section of the menubar must include an option to open a window for modifying the Manim configuration.

Name: Help Menu
Description: The menubar must include a Help section to contain options for help and information on the program.

Name: Licenses
Description: The Help section of the menubar must include an option to view the licenses of the program itself and all libraries used by the program.
